Rashi on Shevuot 14b:12:1.hebrew: ארבעי בתרייתא - ידיעות שבסוף איתנהו בכל התורה, שאין אדם מביא חטאת אא"כ נודע לו שחטא:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:12:1.english: The last four - [the four] awarenesses at the end are found in the entire Torah, for a person does not bring a sin-offering unless it became known to him that he sinned:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:12:2.english: The first four - the [four] awarenesses at the beginning:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:12:3.hebrew: ליתנהו בכל התורה - שהאוכל חלב בשוגג, אפילו לא נודע לו על חתיכה זו מעולם שהיא חלב, ולאחר אכילה נודע לו — חייב:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:12:3.english: [The first four], which are not found in the entire Torah - For one who unwittingly eats forbidden fat, even if it was never made known to him about this piece, that it was forbidden fat, and [only] after eating did he become aware — is liable:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:13:1.hebrew: נעלמו ממנו הלכות טומאה - כשנגע בשרץ, וידע שנגע בשרץ, אבל אינו יודע שהוא טמא:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:13:1.english: The laws of impurity were hidden from him - [This refers to a case] where he touched a creeping animal and knew that he had touched a creeping animal, but does not know that it is impure:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:13:2.hebrew: אי שרץ מטמא - כגון הצב והלטאה שדומין לצפרדע, וסבור שאינו מטמא:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:13:2.english: Whether a creeping animal renders impure - For example, the tortoise and the lizard, which resemble a frog, and he thinks that it does not render impure:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:13:3.hebrew: זיל קרי בי רב הוא - תינוקות של בית רבן קורין בתורה החולד והעכבר והצב, הלכך אין זו העלמה, ויש כאן ידיעה בתחלה, וכשאכל את הקדש נעלמה ממנו נגיעה ראשונה, נמצא שיש כאן ידיעה בתחלה והעלם אחריה, ולכשיודע לו בסוף יהא חייב:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:13:3.english: Go read [this] in the schoolhouse - Schoolchildren read [in the Torah about] the mole, the mouse, and the tortoise. Therefore this is not [considered] a lapse of awareness, and there is awareness here at the outset. [Now,] if when he ate the sacred food the first contact [with impurity] had become hidden from him, there is [still] awareness at the outset and a lapse of awareness after it, and when he becomes aware of it at the end, he should be liable:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:14:1.hebrew: ידיעה היא - ידיעה בתחלה יש כאן:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:14:1.english: It is awareness - There is awareness here at the outset:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:14:2.hebrew: העלמה היא - ואין כאן ידיעה בתחלה:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:14:2.english: It is a [case of] unawareness - and there is no awareness here at the outset:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:15:1.hebrew: בן בבל - שיודע שיש מקדש בירושלים, אבל אין יודע מקומו, מהו? איכא ידיעה בתחלה, או דלמא הא דתנן "נעלם ממנו מקדש" — במי שהכיר בו כבר קאמר:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:15:1.english: A Babylonian - who knows that there is a Temple in Jerusalem but does not know its location, what is the law? Is there [legally relevant] awareness at the outset, or perhaps that which we learned, "the Temple was hidden from him," is speaking of one who had already known it:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:16:1.hebrew: הא לא בעי ידיעה בתחלה - כדאמרינן בשילהי פירקין (דף יט:):
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:16:1.english: But he does not require awareness at the beginning - as we say at the end of this chapter (page 19b):

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:17:1.hebrew: אליבא דרבי - דאמר בשמעתא קמייתא בפרקין קמא (דף ד.): דבעי ידיעה בתחלה, ומחייב על העלם מקדש:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:17:1.english: In accordance with Rabbi - who said in the first passage of our chapter (page 4a) that he requires awareness at the beginning, and deems [one] liable for a lapse of awareness of the Temple:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:17:2.english: Is it awareness - [i.e., is it sufficient] to count as awareness at the beginning:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:17:3.hebrew: או דלמא כיון דמקומו לא נודע לו - מעולם, אין כאן ידיעה בתחלה. ולא דמי לידיעת בית רבו דטומאה, דאילו התם למד שהשרץ מטמא, וכשנגע בו ידע שנגע בשרץ, אבל לא נזכר לו להכיר שהוא טמא בנגיעה זו. התם קאמרינן: כיון שלמד שהנוגע בשרץ טמא, וזה ידע כשנגע, אין זה העלם. אבל זה לא ידע מקום מקדש מימיו, אין כאן ידיעת בית רבו:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:17:3.english: Or perhaps, since its location was not known to him - ever, there is no prior awareness here. And it is not comparable to the awareness of the house of his teacher in the case of impurity, for there he learned that a creeping creature renders [one] impure, and when he touched it he knew that he had touched a creeping creature, but it did not occur to him to recognize that he was impure through this touching. There we say: Since he learned that one who touches a creeping creature is impure, and this person knew when he touched [it], this is not a lapse of awareness. But this person never knew the location of the Temple in his entire life, so there is no [case of] awareness of the house of his teacher here:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:18:1.hebrew: מה"מ - דבעינן כל הני דברים לתוספת עזרה:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:18:1.english: From where [are] these matters [derived]? - That all these [requirements] are necessary for an addition to the Temple courtyard:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:1:1.hebrew: פנימית וחיצונה - מה הדין בהן מפרש בגמרא:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:1:1.english: The inner and the outer - [what is done with them] is explained in the Gemara:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:1:2.english: And [the inner one] is eaten and [the outer one] is burned - this too is explained in the Gemara:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:1.english: He became impure in the courtyard - and he knew that he had become impure:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:2.english: He bowed - while in this state of unawareness:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:3.hebrew: או ששהה כדי השתחואה - בגמרא מפרש שיעורא:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:3.english: Or he tarried long enough to bow - the Gemara explains the measure [of this time]:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:4.hebrew: או שבא לו בארוכה - שיצא לו דרך ארוכה, שיש קצרה הימנו לצאת:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:4.english: Or he went out by a longer [route] - meaning that he left by a long way, when there was a shorter one from which to exit:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:5.hebrew: חייב - ואפי' לא שהה תחלה, ושיעורין הללו הלכה למשה מסיני הם במי שנטמא בתוך העזרה:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:5.english: Liable - Even if he did not tarry at first [upon becoming aware], and these measures [of bowing, tarrying, and the longer route] are a halacha given to Moses at Sinai [that apply] to one who became impure inside the courtyard:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:6.hebrew: בקצרה פטור - היכא דלא השתחוה ולא שהה:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:2:6.english: By the shortest [route], he is exempt - where he did not bow down and did not tarry:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:3:1.hebrew: זו היא - הכוונה לטומאה שאירעה לו בתוך עזרה:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:3:1.english: This is - [it refers to] the impurity that befell him inside the Temple courtyard:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:3:2.hebrew: זו היא מצות עשה שבמקדש - דיש כאן מצות עשה: "וישלחו מן המחנה וגו' וכל טמא לנפש" (במדבר ה׳:ב׳):
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:3:2.english: This is the positive commandment concerning the Temple - For there is here a positive commandment: "And they shall send out of the camp, etc., and everyone who is impure by [contact with] a corpse" (Numbers 5:2):

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:3:3.hebrew: שאין חייבין עליה - בית דין מביאין פר בהוראה, ולא כהן משיח, כדמפרש בגמרא:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:3:3.english: For which they are not liable - The court [brings] a bull [offering] for an erroneous ruling, but not the anointed High Priest, as the Gemara explains:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:4:1.hebrew: ואיזו היא מצות עשה שבנדה כו' - איידי דתנא בהוריות (דף ח:): אין חייבין על עשה שבמקדש, אבל חייבין על עשה שבנדה, קתני הכא: איזו היא מצות עשה שבמקדש, ואיזו היא מצות עשה שבנדה:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:4:1.english: And which is the positive mitzva with regard to a menstruating woman, etc. - Since it is taught in Horayot (8b), "They are not liable for a positive commandment [violated] in the Temple, but they are liable for a positive commandment [violated] with regard to a menstruating woman," it teaches here: Which is the positive mitzva [violated] in the Temple, and which is [the positive mitzva] with regard to a menstruating woman:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:4:2.hebrew: היה משמש עם הטהורה - היינו דומיא דעשה שבמקדש, שאירעה לו הטומאה משבא בהיתר לידי כניסה:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:4:2.english: He was engaging in intercourse with a pure woman - This is similar to the positive commandment concerning the Temple, [where] the impurity occurred to him after he had entered [the Temple] in a permitted manner:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:4:3.hebrew: ואמרה לו נטמאתי - עכשיו, ופירש מיד והוא בקושי האבר:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:4:3.english: And she said to him: I have become impure - just now, and he withdrew immediately, [while] the member [was] still erect:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:4:4.hebrew: חייב - אלא יעמוד בלא דישה עד שימות האבר ויפרוש בלא קושי, וזהו מצות עשה, ובגמרא יליף לה:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:4:4.english: Liable - Rather, he should remain without thrusting until the organ becomes flaccid, and withdraw without erection; and this is the positive commandment. And in the Gemara, [the Gemara] derives it [from a verse]:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:5:1.hebrew: השרץ ונעלם - או בנבלת שרץ טמא ונעלם ממנו (ויקרא ה׳:ב׳):
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:5:1.english: The creeping animal, and it is hidden - “Or the carcass of an impure creeping animal, and it is hidden from him” (Leviticus 5:2):

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:6:1.hebrew: ר' עקיבא אומר כו' - בגמרא מפרש מאי בינייהו:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:6:1.english: Rabbi Akiva says, etc. - The Gemara explains what [the difference] is between them:

Rashi on Shevuot 14b:8:1.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr> - אמר רב פפא: לעולם תמני הויין, וארבעי בתרייתא דמייתן ליה לידי קרבן קחשיב כו' ידיעות אחרונות מודיעות אותו שחטא. ואית דגרסי: ארבעי קמייתא דמייתן ליה לידי קרבן קא חשיב, ואין נראה לי, <abbr title="דאם כן">דא"כ</abbr> מאי איכא דאמרי? אם מפני שנוי הטעם, אין דרך הש"ס לומר כן, ולא ישאל אחריו מאי בינייהו:
Rashi on Shevuot 14b:8:1.english: So we read [in the text]: Rav Pappa said: In truth there are eight, and he is counting the latter four, which bring him to [the obligation of] a sacrifice, etc. The later awarenesses are those that inform him that he sinned. And there are those who read: He is counting the first four, which bring him to [the obligation of] a sacrifice. But this does not seem right to me, for if so, what is [the point of the question] "There are those who say"? If [the difference is] because of a change in the reasoning, it is not the way of the Talmud to say so, and it would not ask after it, "What is [the difference] between them?":

Tosafot on Shevuot 14b:11:1.hebrew: ארבעי קמייתא דלא מייתי ליה לידי קרבן כו' - זאת הגירסא עיקר, וכן נראה לקונטרס. אע"פ שפ"ה בריש מסכת שבת (דף ג. ושם): הנהו דאתו לידי חיוב חטאת קחשיב, דהיינו העקירות, לא קשיא מידי; דהתם מיירי בזה עוקר וזה מניח, ובהנחה אין המניח יכול לבא לידי חיוב חטאת, אבל העוקר היה יכול לבא לידי חיוב חטאת אם היה גומר הוצאה. אבל הכא, בידיעה ראשונה לא נתחייב, ובידיעה האחרונה נתחייב:
Tosafot on Shevuot 14b:11:1.english: The first four [awarenesses], which do not bring him to [liability for] an offering, etc. - This is the primary reading, and so it appears [to be the reading] in the Kuntres [Rashi]. Although Rashi explained at the beginning of tractate Shabbat (3a, there): [The Mishnah] counts those [acts] that lead to liability for a sin-offering, namely the lifting [of the object] — this poses no difficulty. For there [the Mishnah] is speaking of one person lifting and another person depositing, and through the depositing the depositor cannot come to liability for a sin-offering, whereas the lifter could have come to liability for a sin-offering had he completed the transfer. But here, through the first awareness he is not liable, and through the last awareness he is liable:

Tosafot on Shevuot 14b:13:1.hebrew: זיל קרי בי רב הוא - והוי כמו שיש כאן ידיעה, שהיה לו לשאול כיון שדבר זה ידוע לתינוקות. אבל שרץ דמטמא בכעדשה דבסמוך, אין ידוע אלא לתלמידים. וא"ת: תיפוק ליה דידע בבית רבו כשלמד דצב מטמא! וי"ל: בשלא למד, אלא ראה שהעולם נזהרים ולא ידע באיזה. א"נ, למד ולא הבין בין צב לצפרדע מעולם. ועוד יש לפרש "זיל קרי בי רב הוא", כלומר: הרי ע"כ למד בבית רבו שצב כתיב בפרשה. ובתינוק שנשבה ליכא לאוקומה, כיון שיודע דחד מינייהו מטמא:
Tosafot on Shevuot 14b:13:1.english: Go learn in a children's school - And it is as though there is awareness here, [for] he should have asked, since this matter is known to children. But [the case of] a creeping animal that imparts impurity [when it is the size] of a lentil, which is [discussed] shortly below, is known only to scholars. And if you say: Let [the Gemara] derive [his liability] from the fact that he knew in his teacher's house, when he learned, that the tortoise imparts impurity! One can answer: [The case is] where he did not learn, but saw that people are careful, and did not know in regard to which [animal]. Alternatively, he learned, but never distinguished between a tortoise and a frog. Furthermore, one can explain "go learn in a children's school" as meaning: Surely he necessarily learned in his teacher's house that the tortoise is written in the passage. And one cannot establish [the case] as a child who was taken captive, since he knows that one of them imparts impurity:

Tosafot on Shevuot 14b:15:1.hebrew: ונעלם ממנו מקום מקדש מהו - לפי מה שפי' דחשיב ידיעה מה שהיה לו לשאול, צריך לפרש דבזמן הזה מיירי, שאין מצוי לישאל היכן מקומו. ומ"מ נקט בן בבל, לפי שבני א"י רגילין להכיר יותר. ויש תימה, אמאי לא חשיב בכך "ונעלם", מכלל דידע, כמו "ונעלמה מעיני כל חי" (איוב כ״ח:כ״א) דגבי תורה:
Tosafot on Shevuot 14b:15:1.english: And the site of the Temple was hidden from him — what is the ruling? - According to what [Rashi] explained, that [the Gemara] considers it "knowledge" if he had [the opportunity] to ask, one must explain that [the Gemara] is speaking of the present time, when there is no one readily available to ask where its location is. Nevertheless, [the Gemara] specified a Babylonian, because the people of Eretz Yisrael are generally more familiar [with the site]. And it is puzzling: why does [the Gemara] not count this as "hidden" [in the sense of], by implication, that he [previously] knew, as in "and it is hidden from the eyes of all living" (Job 28:21), which is stated regarding Torah:

Tosafot on Shevuot 14b:17:1.hebrew: או דלמא כיון דמקומו לא ידע ליה העלמה היא - פי' בקונטרס: דלא דמי לידיעת בית רבו, דהתם ידע ששרץ מטמא, וכשנגע בשרץ לא נזכר לו שלמד שיהא טמא בנגיעה זו; משמע דלא הויא ידיעת בית רבו ידיעה אא"כ ידע בשעת נגיעה שנגע בשרץ. ולעיל בפ"ק (שבועות דף ה.) דפריך "ומי איכא דלית ליה ידיעת בית רבו", ומשני "משכחת לה בתינוק שנשבה בין הנכרים", ה"מ לשנויי כגון שלא ידע בשעת נגיעה שנגע בשרץ:
Tosafot on Shevuot 14b:17:1.english: Or perhaps, since he does not know its place, it is a lapse of awareness - Rashi explained: This is not like [the case of] the awareness of the house of one's teacher, for there he knows that a creeping creature imparts impurity, and when he touched the creeping creature, it did not occur to him that he had learned that he would be impure through this touching. This implies that the awareness of the house of one's teacher is not [considered] awareness unless he knew, at the time of the touching, that he had touched a creeping creature. And earlier, in the first chapter (Shevuot 5a), where [the Gemara] asks, "And is there anyone who does not have the awareness of the house of his teacher?" and answers, "You can find it in the case of a child who was taken captive among the gentiles," it could have answered [with a case] where he did not know, at the time of the touching, that he had touched a creeping creature:
